title: February 2026 written psychiatry examination recall coverage

source.title: ΠΟΛΛΑΠΛΗΣ ΦΕΒΡΟΥΑΡΙΟΣ 2026
source.kind: User-supplied informal recall, not an official examination or verified answer key

matchDefinition: Same assessable learning target and discriminating answer. Wording need not be verbatim. Broad topic overlap alone is not coverage. Neither existing-item mapping nor metadata proves the recalled answer key.

statusDefinitions.matched_existing: Existing MCQ tests the recalled learning target; no duplicate added.
statusDefinitions.corrected_existing: Existing target had a contradictory key; corrected with sourced explanation.
statusDefinitions.added: New authored reconstruction of the assessable recalled target, not an exact exam transcription.
statusDefinitions.adapted_existing: Existing study question covers a defensible related target after the user authorized adaptation; not an exact match or recovered key.
statusDefinitions.adapted_new: New source-grounded study question resolves an ambiguous recall by specifying its population, scenario, evidence source or learning target; not a recovered key.

scope: Single-best-answer bank src/data/questions.js. Matching sets and vignettes were not counted as substitutes for missing single-best-answer MCQs. No source-locked textbook text was republished.
